work_experiences.job_description:
●	Leading multiple implementation projects onboarding clients on to the ABS Suite platform.
●	Formulating scope and defining project objectives.
●	Managing client relationship by outlining project plan, assisting in critical decisions and ensuring overall program success.
●	Conducting workshops for Treasury, Financial control and Technology teams leading to requirements discovery. 
●	Driving coordination between cross functional teams in regulatory, analytics and automation areas.
●	Teaming up with Product team on custom workflows and requirements to better assist and deliver value to the clients.
●	Developing new directions and approaches backed by analysis and data insights.
●	Working with Principals on defining proposals in response to RFPs.
●     Working on Proof-of-concepts to demonstrate value to the customer and assist sales team in conversions.
●     Conducting brainstorming sessions with CSMs leading to requirements discovery for increase in product adoption.
●	Enhancing knowledge of Securitization and building data dictionaries that aid solution design and development.
●	Reviewing the data sources and interactions required between ABS Suite and client’s upstream systems.
●	Authoring the Interface Control documents defining the data model and frequency for input and output data streams.
●	Configuring ABS Suite to import data from ETL tables or flat files and perform calculations and transformations defined in the ICD.
●	Configuring ABS Suite to support the XML reporting requirements for European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA).
●	Enabling implementation programs through detailed user manuals, training workshops.
●	Carrying out workflow analysis and systems evaluation in upgrading clients to newer software versions.
●	Facilitating test planning, user acceptance testing, training and production roll out activities.

details.description: This study investigates the enhancement of cement concrete pavement strength using polypropylene and polyester fibers. Any pet clinic can provide various online services using this application. Users can see available vets and make appointments. There is also a shop for buying/selling and adopting pets.

This is a research project in machine learning. This project aimed to evaluate machine learning algorithms for predicting depression categories (None, Mild, Severe) among university students in Bangladesh. job_positions.title: Public Relations And Social Media Intern

details.description:
Collaborated with 3 people to implement a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) for fake signature detection and trained the model using two datasets (Tobacco-800 and a custom dataset).
Captured and cleaned signatures from over 1200 publicly accessible documents and excavated features from the model using VGG-16 to maximize the model's accuracy.

Designed and developed an analyzer along with 2 team members to return sentiments in the form of positive, negative, and neutral to help the user invest efficiently in companies. Used web scrapping and open-source libraries like nltk, pandas, and matplotlib to produce an application that recognizes the company by its ticker symbol.

Developed an IoT-based weather monitoring system using NodeMCU and ThingSpeak, that senses temperature, humidity, pressure, and rainfall using several sensors. Enabled the use of the system in numerous applications like farming, disaster prevention, outdoor activities, etc.

Conceptualized and created a system that takes user-defined inputs and recognizes the digit using CNN and Support Vector Machines (SVM) models (a robust comparative study). Teamed up with 3 people to attain a 99.996% accuracy by using Python-based libraries like Streamlit, PyTorch, etc.

Developed a Java-based restaurant-specific application, for a mini-project in the second year, using which users can place and track their orders online. Designed the front-end using XML coding, and used Firebase as the cloud storage service, with a team of 2 members.

Implemented a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for real-time sign language hand-gestures recognition and trained the model using TensorFlow and Keras, achieving a high accuracy. Using over 44 pre-defined gestures captured and created using OpenCV, video stream was integrated for live gesture recognition. As a stand-out feature, we developed interactive modes for text and calculator operations using the recognised gestures.

technical_papers.title: Unveiling Chess Algorithms Using Reinforcement Learning and Traditional Chess Approaches

details.description:
•	Conducted a comprehensive comparative study that explores the core distinctions between multiple reinforcement learning algorithms.
•	 Navigate the terrain where chess, artificial intelligence, and innovation meet.

Published and Presented the paper at the IEEE International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Engineering and Science (ICETES-2023). Our paper not only introduces a pioneering system but also underlines the immense opportunities that emotion detection can unlock such as Healthcare, Security, HCI, and much more.

work_experiences.job_description: I was a machine learning intern here and i made a project of Automated Attendance system for my final evaluation under Dr. Kalpdrum Passi

details.description: Conducted Skin Lesion Analysis using CNN, custom-designed a CNN architecture for lesion identification, and efficiently preprocessed and augmented a diverse dataset. Achieved remarkable model performance.
Its a research paper I am working under Dr. Kalpdrum passi , Laurentian university , Canada .It is accepted and is in publishing state at LNEE at springer.

institutes.name: National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences

users_skills.name: Python, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, computer vision

details.description: The proliferation of satellite imagery has given us a radically improved understanding of our planet. It has enabled us to better achieve everything from mobilizing resources during disasters to monitoring effects of global warming. What is often taken for granted is that advancements such as these have relied on labeling features of significance like building footprints and roadways fully by hand or through imperfect semi-automated methods. This project report is an analysis and implementation of a kernel that was published for the DSTL Satellite Imagery Feature Detection challenge run by Kaggle . The approach is based on an adaptation of fully convolutional neural network for multispectral data processing using UNET and RESNET.

projects.title: Medical Insurance Premium Prediction using Stochastic Variational Inference

details.description:
The purposes of this Project to look into different features to observe their relationship, and used a Bayesian learning approach on several features of individual such as age, physical/family condition and location against their existing medical expense to be used for predicting future medical expenses of individuals that help medical insurance to make decision on charging the premium. 

By using Stochastic Variational Inference,HMC and Gaussian Process.

projects.title: Game of Life Using Q learning: Reinforcement Learning

details.description:
In Game of life by using Q learning approach we develop a autonomous methods in which block find the best possible path and precise path to move into right destination by using Learning Rate and Discount Factor.

Approach used: Bellman Equation,Markov Decision Process,Value iteration.

projects.title: Customers Analysis Through Financial App Behavior Analysis

details.description:
we are worked on financial application data and predict the customer who will take a premium version app subscription or not. Then the company will take action on the customers to give the offers or not. The data contain the customer’s behavior and our job to find the insights from it. 

To complete this project, we use python programming and it’s libraries NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.

projects.title: Design Model Transceiver for IEEE 802.15.4 using ZigBee Technology and Matlab/Simulink

details.description:
Implement a transceiver for ZigBee wireless communication system using Matlab/Simulink designed and tested a ZigBee wireless transceiver in Matlab/Simulink.
	Minimum Shift Keying (MSK) demodulation technique is described and analysed. Which showcased theoretical bandwidth efficiency of MSK is 2 bit/s/Hz, and the result showcases that OQPSK modulation with half sine pulse shaping is perfectly employed in Zigbee technology.
	Using half sine pulse shaping helped in avoiding the abrupt phase shifts

Designed, tested, Simulated and implemented an Electronic Combination Lock using IC 74LS73JK flip-flops, IC 555 Timer, L293D motor drive and transistors.
	Upon pressing switches in order, it sends flip-flops to toggle mode enabling timer to send a predefined width pulse, which rotates the motor for the predefined period to unlock the door.

work_experiences.job_description:
Working collaboratively in a team to successfully complete a project, delivering the final product.
Acquired valuable experience in data science project management, including preprocessing raw data, researching papers, sourcing datasets, and developing pipelines.

Successfully completed several freelance Graphic Design jobs with a strong customer satisfaction rate.
Greeted clients and handled correspondence between the designer and clients.
Fostered a high rate of returning clients due to optimal customer service and aesthetically pleasing graphic design
services.

I co-founded ADSC with my college friends to guide hundreds of our peers to understand the field of Data Science
in its inception.
Conducted seminars in our college and many other colleges in Hyderabad.
Organized guest lectures from well-reputed data science experts for peer guidance.
Arranged Hackathons to help our juniors learn to program
I am known for innovative ideas and creative designs in every aspect.
Music Club Coordinator and member of Coordinator and a member of the Student Council

Effectively supported data-driven marketing and sales activities.
Wrote articles for their website on a regular basis to attract new consumers.
Gave promotional content and promoted the website along with the articles on social media using social media marketing strategies.

projects.title: Attendance management system using facial recognition - Machine learning

details.description:
Created a Machine Learning Model using the iris dataset
It helps to recognize the face of a person after the face's data is preloaded into the data set
It can be used for contact-less attendance

projects.title: Emotion Recognition using Neural Networking - Deep Learning

details.description:
Created a Machine Learning Model using the iris dataset
It helps predict the emotion of a person after the face is scanned in real time
It can be used for speech training, presentation training, etc.

Created a website to help young programmers or beginners to learn the basics of coding
Includes multiple languages and topics for references and assistance

projects.title: Regression model for Tesla stock prediction - Data Analysis

details.description: Performed data analysis and data visualization on a Tesla stock dataset

projects.title: AI for Earth - Microsoft field project

details.description:
I was a part of 4 teams from our college to a field data analysis
Acquired data from farmers in rural ares about the crops, soil and other farmer related problems.
Came up with different solutions for the problems and presented the data in our college

Used a multiple regression model
The multiple regression model to predict the house price using features like number of bedrooms, sqft of the
house, etc

projects.title: Design, modelling and Analysis of MPPT based slope compensated DC-DC converter for PVBattery System Interface. (4th Year B.Tech Project)

details.description: A PV based Distributed Energy Source (DER) was been designed and simulated for a DC Microgrid. PV battery system interface through a DC-DC converter has been modelled and simulated in MATLAB. For such a system the battery is connected at the output of the converter which is charged in a controlled manner and can supply power to loads during odd hours without sunlight. In this project the PV system along with the DC-DC converter has been configured as a controlled current source for charging the battery and supplying power to the load. Current control of the battery Charger unit integrated with MPPT has been realized to achieve maximum operating efficiency under variable atmospheric condition.

details.description:
Trained a 1 vs 1 SVM to classify the fingerprints.
• Achieved Accuracy of 65% using SVM; 75% using Neural Networks.
• Solved Multi-class classification problem using ECOC.
• Extracted HOG features & performed morphological operations to
achieve good results.

Worked with a startup to develop a state-of-the-art Optical
Character Recognition system specifically tailored for financial
documents.
• Used Convolutional Autoencoders to remove grids from documents.
(without loss of text)
• Improved model accuracy from 60% to 90%.
• Designed a system to classify printed and handwritten text using ML.

Followed Agile model of software development to build a web app.
• App connects therapists with parents whose kids have autism, etc.
• Used Django for developing the web app; MySQL for database.
• Implemented detailed use cases for each type of user.
• Designed the format of the data for the API & tested it.

• Deployed an IoT-based solution for measuring soil moisture.
• The soil moisture values read by the sensor were sent by the program
in the micro-controller to the server for temporal analysis

projects.title: Plant Leaf image analysis for detection and prediction of diseases using deep neural networks

details.description:
3 different Convolutional neural networks were used namely, DenseNet 121, ResNet 50, Inception V3. Convolutional neural network models are used to detect Apple plant diseases and diagnose the leaves into 4 categories - healthy, multi-diseased, rust or scab and then the accuracies are compared. The highest accuracy was achieved by DenseNet121 which gives 94.23% as validation accuracy.
This Model was then deployed as backend of the Flask Web Application.

details.description:
• A real-time Image detection application developed using tensor flow and objection detection library published by Google. 
• The project is developed in python and uses Keras deep learning Library for easy and fast prototyping. 
• The project uses the camera attached to the terminal as an input source while converts it into 'NP_Array' named 'image_np' which is then fed to Open-CV2 on wheels that breaks every frame of the feed into arrays. Those arrays are then matched with the pre-developed models.
• Then those arrays are tested and listed under the most accurate label and then passed back to the CV2 to show via the function 'imshow()'.
• As the project is using real-time Machine learning and object Recognition so there is no database other than the models that are trained.
• The whole projects not only can be used to check real-time feeds but can also check a video for the same, in fact, it can also check a single image for objects in it.

technical_papers.title: Medix - Online support  for Doctor, Patient and Hospital

details.description:
• Built on Php. Medix presents a world wide web interactive web application that helps patients, doctors, and hospital to keep track of the patients' prescription. 
• The system is based on Unique Aadhaar Identity which acts as a primary key for the whole database.
• When logged in by the patient by his/her aadhaar id and password he/she will be able to see all the prescriptions given to him/her till data.
• Medix is good for doctor's schedule management and hospital's per doctor-patient statistics management as it contains all the interactions of patient and doctor.
• Talking about the Backend, the programming is fully written in PHP with little JSON for data transferring from database to website and the front end contains Jquery for non-interactive animations, and Google proprietary CSS, materializecss is used for the Material Design look.
• The database was created in MySQL and was then ported to Amazon AWS for vast usability.
• This system has a Simple mail transfer protocol for all the notifications to patients and doctors apart from that the system was capable to send mobile SMS to every patient in order to remind him/her for there appointment automatically.

projects.title: Vehicle Information Storage Container with Video Recovering

details.description: Automobiles and advancing technologies have created a new level of data services in vehicles. The accident of the vehicle means an unexpected event that may cause damage to the body of the vehicle or of a passenger. The main goal of this Black Box project is to use a method to store vehicle accident data (in case an accident occurs), in which image data is taken by an ESP 32 camera while driving and the data is stored in real-time.

technical_papers.title: Vehicle Information Storage Container with Video Recovering

details.description:
The main objective of this project isto store the data taken by the camera when a person
is driving and to use the crash sensor, Temperature sensor, and gas sensor to get the three
major road accident information when an accident occurs the system should be capable of
sending crucial accident data such as an accident alert message with the location of the
accident with its coordinates to the registered mobile number using location services and
message services modules. Published via IEEE
